heroBody: Bring your listening history from Last.fm, Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music – no sign-up – and see the artists, tracks and albums you play the most, your listening clock by hour and your own “Wrapped”, any time, no need to wait for December. Log in with Spotify if you also want your library and to play music right here.
notConfigured: The “timuze buddy” login isn't set up here (VITE_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID is missing). Last.fm, history files and your own Spotify app still work. To enable it, create an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, add the Redirect URI {{redirectUri}} and put the Client ID in your .env file.
featuresTitle: Everything you ever wanted to know about your listening habits.

features.title: Top artists
features.body: A top-3 podium and a chart of up to 99 artists – over 4 weeks, 6 months or 1 year of your listening.

features.title: Top tracks
features.body: The songs you replay the most, plus loyalty, decade taste and peak listening hours.

features.title: Top albums
features.body: Your most played albums, worked out from your top tracks, with cover art.

features.title: Real stream counts
features.body: Bring your Last.fm, Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music history for stream counts, hours listened and a “Wrapped” for every year – merged, with each source's share.

features.title: Heatmap & clock
features.body: See which days and hours you listen, a 24-hour listening clock, and what each data source contributes.

features.title: Private
features.body: No server. Your data stays in your browser.

steps.title: Choose how to start
steps.body: A Last.fm username, a history file or a Spotify login – your pick.

steps.title: Pick a time range
steps.body: 4 weeks, 6 months or a whole year – every stat updates instantly.

steps.title: Explore & add sources
steps.body: Add more sources for the full picture, or look at each one on its own.

outro: Every press of play is a diary entry. timuze helps you read that diary back – beautifully.
footer: timuze · not affiliated with Spotify, Last.fm, YouTube or Apple · data from your own files, Last.fm, Spotify and iTunes Search
